summary: preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: @ornikar/react-native-svg-transformer@1.0.8 ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array rotation primitive `WV8StW`, hex-obfuscated identifiers, no readable symbols). The package's declared purpose is an SVG transformer for React Native, which has no need for a JS runtime download or a 727KB math-named bundle at install time. The `package.json` `files` manifest declares only `index.js`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `README.md`, yet the tarball also ships `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` — both undeclared. The invocation via a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime (Bun) bypasses Node-based lifecycle-hook scanners and executes opaque, un-inspectable code on every installer's machine on `npm install`. The Ornikar-scoped name is a fork of the legitimate `react-native-svg-transformer` by `kristerkari`, which does not ship setup.mjs or math_init.js, consistent with a compromised or malicious republish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
